name: kiwi
description: Source suppliers and negotiate purchases through the Kiwi Buyer MCP server (A2A commerce runtime, pinned @harrylabsj/kiwi@0.8.0 via npx), with the kiwi-buyer sourcing workflow skill bundled. Buyer-side discovery, RFQ, negotiation, non-binding agreements and trade handoff; Kiwi never handles payments or places orders.
